text:
E is an element from Group I of the Periodic Table. Two properties of E are listed.
●
It has a higher melting point than caesium.
●
It has a lower density than sodium.
What is the identity of E?
A
lithium
B
potassium
C
rubidium
D
francium
subject: Chemistry
